about_the_game: The Wander Stars soundtrack is composed by Sayth Vashra (Marcos Daniel Villarejo Castro), with additional music from Stijn van Wakeren. A varied soundscape inspired by popular Japanese musical genres of the 1980s; Jazz Fusion, Prog Rock, City Pop, with a modern and personal touch. 55 tracks that elevate the classic anime visuals to a whole new level!
